caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a pair of eyeglasses, featuring two connected oval frames, each containing a realistically-drawn blue eye with black pupils and surrounding lightly shaded sclera. The frames are colored gold with a metallic finish, and they are joined at the center by a curled, symmetrical bridge. A horizontal, weathered, brown rod extends above the frames and is attached to the top of both ovals by small rings. The background is a uniformly light beige or off-white color, and near the lower right of the eyeglass-like object, the name "John. H. Tercuzzi." is written in small, neat letters.
title: Shop Sign Spectacles
